headline: Alexander Nenkov: Fund of Funds doubles its resources to EUR 1 billion
summary: Alexander Nenkov said the Fund of Funds manages EUR 1 billion for the 2021–2027 programming period. That is twice the resources of the previous programming period.
why: The Fund of Funds channels public money into private investment funds that finance Bulgarian businesses. Its size determines how much capital is available to local companies.
